title: Binance Adds ARB & ID Trading Pairs on Spot Grid
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has opened spot grid trading services for the ARB/BTC, ARB/USDT, ARB/TUSD, ID/BTC, ID/BNB, ID/USDT and ID/TUSD trading pairs.  Set Up Your Spot Grid Trading Strategy Now!
